guide.step1Body: In Channels, click “Scan for a new channel”, connect a bot in the dsh-im panel and create a target; then try “Test delivery” on the Channels page.
guide.step3Body: In the task editor, tick which results to deliver (success / failure / needs decision) and set quiet hours if needed.
guide.step4Body: For tasks that need your go-ahead, set “Approve before run” to require; to avoid false completions, turn on “Evidence required”.
guide.step5Body: Click “Run now” on the task to confirm it works end to end, then leave it to the schedule.
guide.step6Body: Failures and “needs decision” items appear on the Feedback page; approve the latter with “Approve and run”.
